one_liner: Meta's Marketing API (Graph API) for Facebook/Instagram ads is broad and OAuth2-capable, with an official hosted MCP server, but multi-user production use needs App Review, Advanced Access and Marketing API Full Access tier.
auth_notes: Facebook Login OAuth dialog with ads_management/ads_read scope is used to get access to other people's ads. System user tokens generated in Business Manager are static tokens.
access_notes: App creation is self-serve. Managing only your own ad account works with standard access. Managing other people's ad accounts needs advanced access via App Review; the Marketing API Access Tier moves from Limited (development only, heavily rate-limited) to Full after App Review, with ongoing 500-call / under-15%-error requirements.
blocker_notes: Builders can test on their own ad accounts with standard access. Production multi-user OAuth needs Meta App Review (advanced access), Business Verification and Marketing API Full Access tier.

evidence.quote: Depending on your intended use case, you may need to submit your app for review to gain access to specific permissions related to ad management.
If your app is managing other people’s ad accounts, you need advanced access to the `ads_read` and/or `ads_management` permissions.
Have successfully made at least 500 Marketing API calls in the last 15 days.
If you’re managing someone’s ads, use the `scope` parameter to prompt them for the `ads_management` or `ads_read` permissions.
The Marketing API is a collection of [Graph API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api) endpoints and other features that can be used to help you advertise across Meta technologies.
The server is remote-hosted at `https://mcp.facebook.com/ads` and works with any MCP-compatible AI agent.
Meta runs official remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that bring Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Meta Ads capabilities to your agentic workflows.
